context: Request: Labor & Employment matters where the non-compete ran 18 months or longer. Rubric: 1017-00004 (Aurelius Media / Aldrich) and 1038-00006 (Cascade Retail), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads engagement letters and an opening memo of the four matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for covenant and duration words; times out after about 155K chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads engagement letters and memos of two candidate matters from the scan output.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide script listing, per matter folder, the documents that mention a non-compete.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script over all documents of eight named candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads engagement letters, a settlement agreement and closing and dormancy memos of three matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four matters, two of them flagged as proposed rather than operative terms.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Found both qualifying matters but also asserted two matters where the long covenant was only proposed.

first_error.why: It asserted two matters where the long covenant was only a draft or negotiating position, never executed, as qualifying alongside the two that met the request.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a files-with-matches grep for covenant and duration words.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Glob for matter folders; returns nothing.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two ripgrep runs (file list, then matching lines) for practice-group, covenant and duration words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of email reads from seven matters; none from one matter whose emails had matched.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: ripgrep over emails for the practice-group name; lists seven matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: ripgrep for covenant words within five named candidate matters' emails.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of those five matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the covenant memos of four of them.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three matters, two of them flagged as negotiated rather than operative terms.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → List matter folders → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file contents for request keywords → Search within a candidate matter's files → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: A second qualifying matter appeared in its searches but was never opened; the answer omits it and adds two matters with only proposed covenants.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its first grep and its ripgrep runs listed emails of a second qualifying matter, but none of its reading batches or shortlists included that matter, so the answer omits it.

other_errors.why: It asserted two matters where the long covenant was only a draft or negotiating position, never executed.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus two content-mode greps (covenant and duration words; practice-group words).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Four batches of short reads at offsets into emails of seven matters, around the grep hit lines.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four matters, flagging their differing finality.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Found both qualifying matters but also asserted two matters where the long covenant was only proposed.

first_error.why: It asserted two matters whose long covenant appeared only in drafts or a negotiating position as qualifying alongside the two that met the request.

divergence: All three runs reached qualifying matters through content searches, and all three asserted the same two extra matters where a long covenant appeared only in drafts or negotiation (over-inclusion at the write stage). T0 and T2 found both qualifying matters; T1's searches listed the second one but it never opened it (surfaced, not opened, before the over-inclusive write).
